events.title: 리즈 유나이티드 suffer their first league defeat of the season when they are beaten 1–0 at Selhurst Park by 크리스털 팰리스.
John McGrath , the former 프레스턴 노스 엔드 manager, becomes Halifax Town 's 23rd manager in 45 years as successor to Jim McCalliog .
리버풀 sign 19-year-old Welsh-born right back Rob Jones from Fourth Division 크루 알렉산드라 for £300,000.

리즈 유나이티드 get their title challenge back on track with a 4–3 home win over struggling 셰필드 유나이티드, although they are still three points behind leaders 맨체스터 유나이티드, who have two games in hand. 스티브 호지 and Mel Sterland both score twice. 루턴 타운's struggles continue when they lose 4–0 at 애스턴 빌라. 셰필드 웬즈데이 move fourth with a 4–1 home win over 크리스털 팰리스. 테리 버처 , at 32 the youngest manager in the league, has got off to a good start to his second season as manager of 코번트리 시티 , who occupy fifth place after a 1–0 win at 웨스트햄 유나이티드 . Tony Cottee becomes 에버턴's second hat-trick scorer of the league campaign, scoring all three goals in a 3–1 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼.
Rob Jones makes his debut for 리버풀 in a goalless draw with 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford. 마크 휴스 is sent off for the hosts and Gary Ablett is sent off for the visitors.

In a shock move, 케니 달글리시 , who resigned as 리버풀 manager earlier, makes his return to management at second division 블랙번 로버스. A similarly surprising move sees Ray Harford resign as manager of 윔블던, who are placed eighth in the First Division, to become Dalglish's assistant at Ewood Park.

윔블던 replace Ray Harford with 애스턴 빌라's reserve team coach, Peter Withe . John Impey , who won promotion to the Third Division with 토키 유나이티드 just weeks after his appointment as manager last season, is sacked after six months in the job after his side lost seven out of eight games in the league. 28-year-old player Wes Saunders is appointed caretaker manager – making him the youngest manager in the Football League. Winger Jimmy Carter moves from 리버풀 to 아스널 for £500,000.

케니 달글리시 has a dream start with his new team, 블랙번 로버스, who crush struggling 플리머스 아가일 5–2 and stand fourth in the league. 미들즈브러 remain top despite being held to a goalless draw at home by seventh-placed 울버햄프턴 원더러스 . 입스위치 타운 , second in the table, are held to a 2–2 draw by Brighton at the Goldstone Ground . 케임브리지 유나이티드 are third after an impressive 3–0 home win over 선덜랜드 .

England beat Turkey 1–0 at Wembley in their penultimate 1992 European Championship qualifying game. Wales lose 4–1 to Germany in a game in which Dean Saunders is sent off and 라이언 긱스, still not 18 until the end of next month, becomes their youngest full international.
에버턴 buy 20-year-old defender Matt Jackson from 루턴 타운 for £600,000.

아스널's four-match winning run in the league ends with a 1–1 draw against leaders 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford . Second placed Leeds cut the gap at the top to two points with a 4–2 win at 노츠 카운티 , although 알렉스 퍼거슨 's men still have a game in hand. 리버풀 's relatively short start to the season continues with a 2–2 draw at 첼시 and they still only occupy 10th place, although they have played fewer games than any of the teams above them. 셰필드 유나이티드 remain bottom despite a 4–2 home win over 노팅엄 포리스트 , only their second win in the league this season.
Fourth Division strugglers 요크 시티 dismiss manager John Bird after winning just 2 of their first 11 games.

저스틴 파샤누 signs a trial contract with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 , who are battling against relegation from the Second Division. 케니 달글리시 makes his first signing for 블랙번 로버스, signing defender Alan Wright from 블랙풀 F.C. for £500,000 – a record fee for a Fourth Division player.

The last unbeaten start in the First Division ends when 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose their 13th game of the season 3–2 at 셰필드 웬즈데이. They also surrender their leadership of the First Division, which is taken by 리즈 유나이티드 after their 1–0 win over 올덤 애슬레틱 – the first time that Leeds have led the English league since they won the league title in 돈 레비 's last season as manager in 1974. 아스널 keep their hopes of retaining the league title on track with a 2–0 home win over 노츠 카운티 , who are now just one place above the relegation zone after their fine start to the season gave way to a run of bad results. 맨체스터 시티 are third in the league and four points off the top of the table after a 3–2 home win over 셰필드 유나이티드.

요크 시티 appoint John Ward as their new manager. The club had initially been set to appoint Billy McEwan as successor to John Bird, but a dispute over wages and the personal recommendation of England manager 그레이엄 테일러 resulted in outgoing City chairman Michael Sinclair appointing Ward in his last major decision before handing his own role over to Douglas Craig.

The Second Division promotion race is still led by 미들즈브러, but second place is now occupied by a 케임브리지 유나이티드 side in the hunt for a unique third successive promotion. The play-off zone is occupied by 찰턴 애슬레틱, 스윈던 타운, 입스위치 타운 and 더비 카운티.
